title: Spaghetti with meatballs
intro: Spaghetti and meatballs is an Italian-American classic built from tender beef meatballs simmered in a rich tomato sauce, a dish that grew up in Italian immigrant kitchens rather than in Italy itself. Its appeal is straightforward: soft, juicy meatballs and a deeply savoury sauce, both coaxed from a short list of everyday ingredients.
